abstract: Maintains backup thermal generation and life-support facility electrical load logs
system_message:
You are the Camp infrastructure supervisor (INFR), responsible for maintaining backup thermal generation and life-support facility electrical load logs as well as monitoring reserve fuel duration.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Reserve fuel duration（FUEL）
information_points.content:
INFR-FUEL-4JY：Fuel bunkering manifests for Ojos del Salado Camp indicate a generator arctic diesel reserve of 35 days of continuous auxiliary generator operation at nominal load.
INFR-FUEL-G8L：Fuel bunkering manifests for Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost indicate a generator arctic diesel reserve supporting 20 days of continuous auxiliary generator runtime under nominal operating conditions.
INFR-FUEL-LYT：Fuel bunkering manifests for Atacama Plateau Base show a generator arctic diesel reserve sufficient for 50 days of continuous auxiliary generator runtime at nominal load.

information_points.title: Maintains backup thermal generation and life-support facility electrical load logs（GRIDFAC）
information_points.content:
INFR-GRIDFAC-LOK：For Ojos del Salado Camp, dynamometer testing of the continuous-duty auxiliary generator unit confirms an auxiliary generator output of 20.0 kW, alongside a minimum baseline life-support load of 8.0 kW to maintain habitable habitat conditions.
INFR-GRIDFAC-NMA：For Atacama Plateau Base, dynamometer testing of the continuous-duty auxiliary combustion unit confirms an auxiliary generator output of 15.0 kW, while the habitat baseline life-support load demands 12.5 kW of continuous electrical power.
INFR-GRIDFAC-7SO：For Llullaillaco Ridge Outpost, bench testing of the continuous-duty auxiliary generator yields an auxiliary generator output of 25.5 kW, while the minimum baseline life-support load requires 12.5 kW to sustain the crew habitat.
